reference: DaVinci Resolve Studio 21.1 (public documentation, Blackmagic's documented scripting stub, and a read-only inspection of the local install's PE headers, version resources and export-name tables; nothing was disassembled, executed or copied; Pirosman is not affiliated with Blackmagic Design)

features.reference: Media page: import clips by reference into a Media Pool, inspect clip metadata
features.evidence: Resolve Reference Manual, Media page chapters
features.notes: Resolve references media in place and shows codec/resolution/frame-rate per clip.
features.approach: Native file dialog or OS drag-drop → FFprobe JSON → MediaRef with UUID, path, full-file SHA-256, size/mtime, stream metadata; thumbnails, waveforms and H.264 proxies built in the background.
features.verification: Unit tests probe_parses_av_file, probe_detects_images_and_audio, hash_is_full_content_sha256; integration import_edit_save_render_verify; demo media imported in the running app
features.limitations: No bins/folders, smart bins, or metadata editing. Proxies are 720p H.264.

features.evidence: Reference Manual: offline clips / Relink
features.notes: Resolve flags media offline and relinks by searching folders.
features.approach: Status from file presence + size/mtime; relink requires an identical SHA-256 unless the user explicitly accepts different content; bundle import auto-relinks by hash.
features.verification: Unit test status_detects_missing_and_modified; integration test hash_checked_relink moves a file, confirms it reads as missing, accepts the identical copy and rejects different content unless forced
features.limitations: Relinks one file at a time; no folder search.

features.reference: Still images and photos on the timeline with an adjustable duration
features.evidence: Reference Manual: stills and standard still duration preference
features.notes: Resolve uses a project-wide default still duration, changeable per clip by trimming.
features.approach: PNG/JPEG/TIFF/BMP/WebP import as kind=image; placed for 5 s by default; the Inspector's still-length field and normal trims change it; rendered with -loop 1.
features.verification: Integration test v3_photo_transform_vfx_and_still renders a photo clip frame-exact (60/60)
features.limitations: No image sequences; no Ken Burns keyframes (transform is static per clip).

features.reference: Multitrack timeline: place, move, trim, blade, delete, ripple, slip, slide, roll, insert and overwrite edits; linked A/V
features.evidence: Reference Manual, Edit page and trimming chapters
features.notes: Resolve also offers dynamic trim and nested timelines.
features.approach: Transactional Rust operations on integer frames; linked picture+sound groups; every edit validated (overlap, media bounds, locks) before it replaces the project.
features.verification: Unit tests incl. slip_moves_source_not_timeline, slide_trims_neighbours, roll_moves_the_cut, insert_splits_and_ripples, overwrite_replaces_the_range; drag/trim/blade/F9/F10 exercised in the running app
features.limitations: No dynamic (JKL) trim, no nested/compound clips, no multicam.

features.reference: Source and timeline viewers with transport, keyboard control and layout options
features.evidence_type: official documentation and common NLE convention
features.evidence: Reference Manual viewer chapters
features.notes: Resolve composites every track in real time.
features.approach: Live viewer plays the topmost visible clip with CSS approximations of fades (opacity), transform, crop, effects and titles; every audio track plays through its own Web Audio strip (clip gain × fader × fade, pan, 3-band EQ, mute/solo). Swap, single/dual and floating viewer; draggable splitters. 'Render preview' shows the exact FFmpeg result.
features.verification: Checked in the running app over CDP: fade opacity 0.524 at frame 10 of a 20-frame fade, transform/crop styles, vignette/grain overlays, float/dock, swap, splitters
features.limitations: Live preview shows one video layer; cross dissolves preview as a fade; reverse playback steps by seeking; effect previews are approximations. The floating viewer is an in-app window, not a separate OS window.

features.evidence: Reference Manual: Edit menu
features.approach: EditHistory in the core crate: snapshot stacks (200 steps) with labels; no-op edits are not recorded; restore/switch/merge/live edits are single undoable steps.
features.verification: Unit tests multi_step_undo_redo_restores_exact_states and no_op_edits_are_not_recorded_and_limit_holds; undo labels checked in the running app
features.limitations: Undo history is not persisted across launches (revisions are).

features.reference: Fades, cross dissolves and dip to black
features.evidence: Reference Manual: transitions and fade handles
features.approach: Per-clip fade_in/fade_out frames and an incoming transition on the later clip; render uses handles for dissolves (xfade-equivalent overlay with alpha) and fade filters; dissolves without handles are rejected with an explanation.
features.verification: Unit tests fades_and_transitions, cross_dissolve_extends_handles; integration v2_features_render_frame_exact (160/160 frames)
features.limitations: Two transition types; no wipes or custom curves.

features.evidence: Reference Manual: Change Clip Speed
features.approach: speed (0.1–10) and reversed on the clip; timeline duration = round(source/speed); render uses setpts/reverse and an atempo chain for audio.
features.verification: Unit tests speed_changes_timeline_duration, speed_and_reverse, fades_speed_reverse_and_lut; integration render frame-exact
features.limitations: No ramps or optical flow; reverse loads the clip range into memory in FFmpeg.

features.evidence: Reference Manual: Text title generator
features.approach: TitleClip items on video tracks (text, size, colour, position, fades), rendered with drawtext via text files.
features.verification: Unit tests titles_and_markers, titles_mixer_range_and_formats; title overlay checked in the running app
features.limitations: One font (system sans); no animation or styling beyond colour/size/position.

features.evidence: Reference Manual: markers, marking In and Out
features.approach: Project markers (colour, name, note) and mark_in/mark_out; I/O address the active viewer; the Deliver page can render In to Out.
features.verification: Unit tests titles_and_markers, titles_mixer_range_and_formats (range render); integration range render 50 frames; M/I/O keys checked in the running app
features.limitations: No clip markers or marker export.

features.evidence: Reference Manual: Edit menu
features.approach: Core Clipboard keeps clips with their track kind; paste overwrites at the playhead with fresh clip UUIDs and remapped link ids; one undoable step.
features.verification: Unit test copy_paste_duplicate_mint_fresh_ids; Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V checked in the running app (fresh ids, undo label)
features.limitations: In-app clipboard only (not the OS clipboard); no paste attributes.

features.reference: Inspector transform (zoom, position, rotation) and crop
features.evidence: Reference Manual: Inspector Transform and Cropping
features.approach: Clip.transform (scale x/y, position x/y as frame fractions, rotation) and Clip.crop (0–0.45 per edge); render: crop → fit → grade → effects → scale/rotate → centred overlay; preview: CSS transform and clip-path.
features.verification: Unit tests transform_crop_vfx_and_still, transform_fields_and_vfx_merge; integration v3_photo_transform_vfx_and_still
features.limitations: Static per clip (no keyframes); no anchor point or flip.

features.reference: Per-clip effects: blur, glow, vignette, film grain, chromatic aberration
features.evidence: Reference Manual: Resolve FX library (Blur, Glow, Vignette, Film Grain, Chromatic Aberration)
features.notes: Resolve's own effects are proprietary; Pirosman builds original equivalents from stock FFmpeg filters.
features.approach: Ordered Vfx stack with amount and bypass, tracked by id in diffs and merges; FFmpeg gblur, split+gblur+blend=screen, vignette, noise, rgbashift.
features.verification: Unit tests transform_crop_vfx_and_still, v2_clip_changes_are_described, transform_fields_and_vfx_merge; integration v3 render
features.limitations: Five effects with one amount each; the live viewer approximates them with CSS.

features.evidence_type: official documentation and local install inspection
features.evidence: Fusion chapters of the Reference Manual; fusionsystem.dll (24,612 exports) and 15 Fusion plugins in the 21.1 install
features.approach: Not started. Track stacking, transform, crop, titles and the effect stack cover simple layering only.
features.limitations: No nodes, keying, masks or tracking.

features.reference: Primary corrections: lift, gamma, gain, contrast, saturation
features.evidence: Color page Primaries chapters
features.notes: Resolve applies per-channel wheels inside a node graph.
features.approach: Per-clip master values stored on the clip (validated ranges); export applies FFmpeg colorlevels + eq; viewer approximates with an SVG filter of the same math.
features.verification: Unit tests plan_applies_color_and_gain_and_mutes, neutral_color_emits_no_filter; graded renders
features.limitations: Master (not per-channel) controls; no nodes or curves; preview-vs-export pixel equivalence not measured.

features.evidence_type: official documentation and local install inspection
features.evidence: Reference Manual LUT chapters; 109 .cube files found under the install's LUT folders
features.approach: Clip.lut path; FFmpeg lut3d (trilinear) after the primaries; path escaped for the filtergraph.
features.verification: Unit tests fades_speed_reverse_and_lut, filter_paths_are_escaped; integration render with a generated LUT
features.limitations: Not shown in the live viewer (scopes and Rendered preview include it); LUT files are referenced, not bundled.

features.evidence: Reference Manual: Video Scopes
features.approach: The exact rendered frame (grade, LUT, effects) is decoded to rgb24 and binned into column × level grids; drawn on canvas with clip/crush readouts.
features.verification: Unit test bins_a_known_frame; scopes drawn in the running app
features.limitations: Updates when the playhead settles, not during playback; no vectorscope or histogram.

features.evidence: Reference Manual: Gallery stills
features.approach: One-frame PNG render of the graded timeline at the playhead through the export pipeline.
features.verification: Unit test transform_crop_vfx_and_still; integration v3 writes a 640-wide PNG
features.limitations: No gallery, wipes or still comparison.

features.reference: Clip gain, track fader, pan, EQ, mute/solo, meters
features.evidence_type: official documentation and local install inspection
features.evidence: Fairlight page chapters; FairlightPage.dll 21.1.0.103 in the install
features.notes: Resolve offers buses, dynamics and automation.
features.approach: Export: per-clip volume and fades, per-track volume, 3-band equalizer, pan, solo/mute, amix normalize=0. Preview: one Web Audio strip per track with peak meters.
features.verification: Unit tests titles_mixer_range_and_formats, solo_isolates_tracks, mixer_patch_validates; integration WAV/M4A renders; mixer exercised in the running app
features.limitations: No buses, dynamics, automation or loudness metering.

features.evidence_type: public specification, community documentation, local install inspection
features.evidence: OpenFX bundle layout; the 21.1 install ships its own 'DaVinci Resolve Renderer' OFX bundle and OFXLoader.exe
features.notes: Resolve hosts plugins out of process (OFXLoader.exe).
features.approach: Bundles in Common Files\OFX\Plugins, OFX_PLUGIN_PATH and the app's ofx\Plugins are listed; each binary is then described by pirosman-ofxhost in its own process (load, describe, describe in context) and cached by size and modification time. The Effects library shows one tab per vendor.
features.verification: Unit tests ofx_discovery_lists_without_loading, binaries_found_for_this_platform_only, vendor_tabs_from_groupings; scan of the bundled sample plugins in clip_renders_through_sample_plugins
features.limitations: Windows x64 binaries only. A plugin that refuses non-Resolve hosts (such as Resolve's own renderer bundle) is listed as unsupported with its reason.

features.evidence: OpenFX 1.4 host API: property, image effect, parameter, memory, multi-thread, message, time line and progress suites
features.notes: Like Resolve's OFXLoader.exe, plugins run out of process so a crash cannot take down the editor.
features.approach: Clips carry an OpenFX stack (plugin id, parameter values). Before a render, FFmpeg decodes each affected clip as rgba64le, pirosman-ofxhost runs the frames through the stack (filter or general context, byte/short/float RGBA, temporal access within ±4 frames), and FFmpeg encodes a cached intermediate that the render plan reads instead of the media. The paused viewer shows the exact frame rendered the same way.
features.verification: End-to-end test clip_renders_through_sample_plugins (white clip → Tint → render plan → PNG checked blue); property-store unit test; manual Tint → Posterize → Echo chain over testsrc2
features.limitations: Parameters are static per clip (no keyframes); no overlays/interacts, custom or parametric parameters, transitions, generators or GPU render paths. Commercial plugins (Sapphire, BCC, …) need their own licences and have not been tested here.

features.reference: Deliver page: format, codec, resolution, frame rate, range, progress, cancel
features.evidence: Deliver page chapters
features.notes: Resolve renders through its own engine and a render queue.
features.approach: Render plan → inspectable FFmpeg arguments and filtergraph; H.264, HEVC, MPEG-4, ProRes 422, DNxHR HQ, audio-only WAV/M4A; whole timeline or In to Out; -progress; cancel; .partial then rename; ffprobe verification.
features.verification: Unit tests plan_trims_offsets_and_maps_streams, settings_validation, titles_mixer_range_and_formats; integration import_edit_save_render_verify, v2_features_render_frame_exact (HEVC/DNxHR/WAV/M4A, 50-frame range), cancelled_render_leaves_no_file
features.limitations: One job at a time, no queue; encoders depend on the local FFmpeg build.

features.evidence: Project Manager chapters
features.notes: Resolve stores projects in a database.
features.approach: Versioned JSON .pirosman file, atomic save with .bak, validation with readable errors, unknown fields preserved; Save/Save As/Open/Reload, Saved/Unsaved pill, recent list in the app config dir; inline rename.
features.verification: Unit tests save_and_reopen_preserves_edits, load_reports_useful_errors, serde_roundtrip_preserves_ids_and_unknown_fields, v2_defaults_serialize_like_v1
features.limitations: No autosave.

features.reference: Timeline import: FCP 7 XML, OpenTimelineIO, Resolve .drp/.drt archives
features.evidence_type: documented scripting API and local install inspection
features.evidence: DaVinciResolveScript.pyi export constants EXPORT_FCP_7_XML, EXPORT_OTIO, EXPORT_DRT, EXPORT_AAF, EXPORT_EDL (read from the local install)
features.notes: The .drp/.drt payload format is proprietary and undocumented; Pirosman does not reverse it.
features.approach: xmeml (roxmltree) and OTIO parsers into the native model; media re-probed and hashed; overlaps refused; transitions without handles become dips. .drp/.drt are opened as ZIP: embedded xmeml/OTIO is imported, otherwise only the media list is recovered with a warning.
features.verification: Unit tests imports_fcp7_xml, otio_round_trip_through_our_exporter, resolve_archive_with_embedded_xml_and_media_only_fallback, url_decoding
features.limitations: No AAF, EDL or FCPXML import; native .drp timelines without an embedded interchange file import media only; effects/grades are not carried.

features.evidence: EXPORT_OTIO in DaVinciResolveScript.pyi
features.approach: Writes OTIO JSON: stacks, tracks, gaps, transitions, LinearTimeWarp for retimes, exact rational rates.
features.verification: Unit tests timeline_structure_gaps_and_transitions, retime_becomes_linear_time_warp, ntsc_rate_is_exact_float; re-import round trip
features.limitations: Import into Resolve itself not verified in this session.

features.reference: Not a Resolve feature (Resolve offers backups, bin/timeline locks and a project server)
features.evidence: blackmagicdesign.com DaVinci Resolve collaboration page
features.approach: Content-addressed immutable revisions, branches, stash-before-switch, restore, semantic diffs by UUID (incl. transform, crop and effect-stack changes), three-way property-level merge with conflicts.
features.verification: Unit tests for commits, integrity, branches, every diff category, merge cases (incl. transform_fields_and_vfx_merge); commit/branch/merge/restore exercised in the running app
features.limitations: No rebase, cherry-pick or history rewriting; history lives next to the project file.

features.evidence: Resolve uses a shared project database / Blackmagic Cloud with bin and timeline locks
features.approach: .pirosman-bundle ZIP with manifest, revisions and optional media; strict validation; incoming branches land under incoming/<name>.
features.verification: Unit tests export_import_roundtrip, rejects_foreign_project, rejects_traversal_and_malformed, rejects_tampered_revision; integration revision_bundle_and_merge_workflow
features.limitations: Manual file exchange only.

features.evidence: Resolve collaboration page (Project Server / Blackmagic Cloud)
features.notes: Opt-in Live Sync mode next to the default, network-free Revisions mode.
features.approach: WebSocket hub (tungstenite) inside the app, guarded by a session code; peers exchange presence (pointer, page, playhead, selection) and whole-project snapshots after each transactional edit; remote snapshots go through the Rust model as an undoable 'Live edit by …' step. UI: remote cursors with name tags, ghost playheads, presence borders on clips, Invite/Host dialog, second-window launcher.
features.verification: Unit test relays_between_peers_and_rejects_wrong_code; in the running app a hosted session with a second WebSocket peer showed cursor, ghost playhead, presence border, and applied the peer's edit with an undo label; Revisions mode stops hub and socket
features.limitations: Last writer wins on whole-project snapshots (no operational merge); plain ws:// on the LAN with a 6-character code, no TLS or accounts; media must exist on each machine; the second-window launcher was not exercised while a CDP-debug instance was running.

features.reference: Read-only inspection of the installed Resolve Studio
features.evidence: Resolve Studio 21.1 install: Resolve.exe 21.1.0.17 (1,095 exports), fusionsystem.dll 21.1.0.12 (24,612), fusionscript.dll (3,065), FairlightPage.dll 21.1.0.103, Qt5Core 5.15.2, avcodec-60 60.3.100, 251 DLLs
features.notes: Only PE headers, version resources, export-name tables, file listings and Blackmagic's documented scripting stub were read.
features.approach: Own PE parser (DOS/PE header, section table, export directory, RT_VERSION VS_FIXEDFILEINFO) with bounded seeks; install-tree survey; shown in Help → Resolve binary & interop inspector.
features.verification: Unit tests reads_a_real_system_dll, rejects_non_pe, parses_documented_export_constants, missing_install_is_reported_not_fatal; example run against the 21.1 install
features.limitations: Nothing is disassembled, decompiled, loaded or executed by design; findings describe structure and versions, not behaviour.
